statements.markdown:
**Theorem B.1 (the exact denominator period).** *Let $F\subseteq\mathbb{N}_{>0}$ be finite and nonempty, let $b\ge2$ be an integer, and let $D_F>0$ be the denominator of $X_F(b)$ in lowest terms. Then $D_F$ is coprime to $b$, and*
$$
\operatorname{ord}_{D_F}(b)=\operatorname{lcm}\{n:n\in F\}.
$$
*If moreover $\operatorname{lcm}(F)\ge2$, then $\operatorname{lcm}(F)<D_F$. We use $\operatorname{ord}_1(b)=1$, so the statement includes $F=\{1\}$ at $b=2$.*
